listing.aiSummary: Adds a slot machine gambling den to ports of size 6 or larger, allowing players to trade ships and blueprints for tokens to play slots.

description:
Gambling Den

A gambling den at every port of size 6 or larger.

Trade in surplus ships and duplicate blueprint chips for tokens, then waste them responsibly on Slots.
Choose one to five reels and stakes of 1, 2, 4, or 8 tokens per reel.

Wins can pay credits, more tokens, weapon crates, or hullmod blueprint boxes.
Hullmod boxes skip blueprints you already know. Win something and you can take it, or double or nothing.

Requires LunaLib.

Screenshot
Five reels, an 8-token stake, a medium weapon-crate win, and the always sensible Double or nothing button.

Details
Available as a permanent dockside option at markets of size 6+.
Sell ships for tokens; fleet points determine value and d-mods reduce it. Your flagship is protected.
Each reel rolls and pays independently. If every reel wins, the payout doubles.
Weapon crates and hullmod boxes come in three sizes.
LunaLib sliders tune crate sizes, payouts, odds, and ship trade-in value while the game is running.
No duplicate hullmod blueprints: unavailable blueprint rewards convert to credits.

Version log
1.0.0
Initial stable release: ship-to-token trading, configurable one-to-five-reel Slots, credits/tokens/weapon crates/hullmod boxes, duplicate protection, and double or nothing.

The cabinet design is inspired by the Tachy-Impact machine from Interastral Peace Casino by Emanon6 and WolframSegler.

discordPostHtml:
https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=35993 A small mod I made
On every size 6+ planet, there is now an option to visit the gambling den. Inside, you will (in 1.0.0) find 1 slot machine. This slot machine works from "tokens" - Currency you gain by SELLING SHIP HULLS.

From the slot machine, you have the option to select your bet per "reel" - Per vertical column. You can select up to 5 columns.

Pachinko Machine (1.1.0+) - Spend your tokens in a fully physics-based pachinko machine. Choose weapons, hullmods or tokens to gamble for.

These tokens are used to play a configurable slot machine with one to five reels and various stakes. Wins can yield credits, more tokens, weapon crates, or hullmod blueprint boxes, with options to double or nothing.
